title: An idea becomes a connected system — Editorial Design preview

scenes.title: The lone idea
scenes.purpose: Establish the still drafting-stock spread and a single vermilion spark as the idea.
visuals: Cool blue-grey drafting page with faint printed grid, navy masthead, rules and folio (stationary)
Vermilion spark grows at page centre

beats.development: Spark scales in at the centre of the empty spread; masthead and rules already set.

scenes.title: Layout reflow
scenes.purpose: Grouped movement carries the spark into the image grid while the figure panel opens through a mask and the headline rises line by line.
visuals: Spark glides to the figure hub
Circular mask opens the hatched figure panel from the hub
Headline lines rise through per-line masks in reading order

beats.development: Spark travels to the hub; panel mask expands; headline lines reveal.

scenes.title: The system connects
scenes.purpose: Show the idea reaching outward: spokes draw, nodes appear on arrival, rim links close the structure, body copy and caption follow in reading order.
visuals: Seven spokes draw from the hub, each node appears after its spoke arrives
Rim links draw between outer nodes
Accent rule grows; two body columns reveal line by line
Caption reveals after the panel is complete

beats.development: Spokes draw outward and nodes pop in at their endpoints; accent rule grows.
Rim links close the network; body columns and figure caption reveal.
captions: Every network begins as a single point of thought, then learns to reach outward.
Links multiply, the pattern holds, and the whole grows larger than its parts.
Fig. 1 — From a single spark to a working structure.

beats.development: No motion; reading hold on the finished layout.

findings: Reveals follow reading order: spark, headline, figure links, body, caption.
All motion completes by 2.44 s; composition is settled before 2.7 s.
Body copy gets only a short settled hold in a 3 s preview; full reading would need a longer cut.
justifiedHolds: 2.45–3.0 s final hold lets the finished spread register.

notes: Background refreshed from the warm swatch to a scene-dependent cool blue-grey drafting stock (#E4E9EE) with navy ink (#1B2838); vermilion #A84235 kept only for the spark, italic 'connected' and accent rule.
No optional recipes were supplied (tech.preview_recipes empty); the refresh demonstrates the background-review lessons rather than a new recipe.
